title: Hugh Earle of Caesarea
summary: Raleigh names Hugh Earle of Caesarea in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Hugh Earle of Caesarea, with whom William of Tyre had full discourse of the Caliphs estate. The Earle sent to the Caliph, whose name is a gap, was not filled, and was not equated with this Hugh. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXVI, §. I, sig. 355b–356a
